answer: Beacon checks and a heartbeat stop fakes. Each agent posts a 20 POA bond and heartbeat on a timber board. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% at random for a surprise task due in 1 hour, sealed in umber ink. A miss or copy slashes the bond and halves standing; twice voids it. 1,000 fakes lock 20,000 POA and burn 2,000 POA an epoch, each earning under 5. An honest agent pays a bond, meets one check in twenty epochs like a zephyr, keeping its reward.
